notes:
Summary: VeloxAI is a mid-market helpdesk/chat SaaS building multi-agent workflows and live chat handoffs. Primary driver is recent latency regressions with their incumbent LLM API (causing agent handoff delays and unhappy end-users). They've scoped a POC to benchmark streaming behavior and tool-calling reliability.

Requirements / priorities:
- Workload: production chat + agent orchestration (streaming first token to UI, tool calling for calendar/CRM ops).
- Latency SLO: target ~<=200ms p50 token streaming for handoffs; p95 < 500ms. Real-time feel critical for UX.
- Throughput: baseline 30-60 concurrent active agents (avg 50 req/s at peak), burst to 200 req/s during events.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; prefers Hosted initially, then Dedicated for predictable costs and VPC.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS encryption, option for data residency in us-east.

POC details so far:
- Redwood SE setup: streaming with SSE + tool-calling demo. Continuous batching tuned for chat.
- Benchmarking: team ran parallel tests vs incumbent, same prompt set (customer support dialogues, tool call triggers). Redwood streamed tokens with lower per-token latency (p50 ~120ms) vs incumbent (p50 ~260ms) in our runs — Velox saw visible improvement during live UI tests.
- Quote from CTO (Paraphrase): "If we can't get a consistent streaming feel, product drops. Need 200ms p50 or better across peak traffic or we'll consider Dedicated + colocated routing."

Concise next actions / owner notes:
- AE (Riley) to deliver final POC SLA + Hosted pricing tiers (due 2025-02-18).
- SE (Priya) to run a 48h continuous streaming benchmark vs incumbent (scripted user flows) and share raw logs + summary (due 2025-02-20).
- Security to provide sample BAA + confirm data residency options for us-east (legal loop).
- Blocker: Velox wants independent verification of latency improvements during business hours (US peak). They will withhold final commitment until 48h benchmark completed and legal sign-off.
